# Codebase Map — DataNeel/yo_pid

<!-- generated by autobuild-setup skill v1.0.3; updated by autobuild onboarding 2026-09-22 -->

## Overview

Single-file bash script repo. No subdirectories (outside `.obvious/`), no packages, no services, no CI workflows.

## Directory Structure

```
yo_pid/
├── .gitignore
├── .obvious/
│   ├── codebase-map.md   ← this file
│   ├── config.yml
│   ├── obvious.md
│   └── skills/
│       └── local-dev/
│           └── SKILL.md
├── README.md
└── yo_pid.sh
```

## Files

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `yo_pid.sh` | Main bash script — runs a command or monitors a PID, then sends a Yo notification via the Yo API |
| `README.md` | Usage instructions and Yo API setup guide |
| `.gitignore` | Excludes `.obvious-install/` progress directory |
| `.obvious/obvious.md` | Agent guidance for Autobuild |
| `.obvious/config.yml` | Autobuild configuration (squash merge, master default base) |
| `.obvious/skills/local-dev/SKILL.md` | Durable record of local-dev onboarding and verification evidence |

## Stack

- **Language:** Bash
- **Runtime:** Any Unix shell with `curl` and `ps`
- **Package manager:** None
- **Build system:** None
- **Test framework:** None
- **CI:** None

## Entry Points

| Entry | Command | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `yo_pid.sh` | `./yo_pid.sh -c '{COMMAND}' -u {YO_NAME}` | Run a command, send Yo on completion |
| `yo_pid.sh` | `./yo_pid.sh -p {PID} -u {YO_NAME}` | Monitor a PID, send Yo when activity stops |
